notes.title: Support Quest for the Albatross on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
🏌️ Our Kickstarter is COMING SOON – Help Us Bring Quest for the Albatross to Life!
Hey golfers, wizards, and fantasy fans!

We’re incredibly excited to announce that the Kickstarter campaign for Quest for the Albatross is officially running through August! 🎉

👉 Click here to back the campaign!

If you’ve enjoyed the demo or have been following along with development, now’s your chance to be part of the magic. Your support will help us:

Build new biomes, spells, and game modes (like the epic Siege Mode)

Finish our handcrafted campaign story

Polish the art, audio, and UI to the level the game deserves

Bring Quest for the Albatross to full launch on Steam (and maybe beyond!)

We’ve got some awesome rewards for backers, including digital artbooks, naming in-game content, early access, and more. ✨

Thank you so much for being here at this early stage—we truly couldn’t do this without you. 💚

Let’s hit the greens and make something legendary.

—The Quest for the Albatross Team

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
🏌️ Devlog #2 – Demo Launch, Siege Mode, and What’s Next!
Hey everyone!

The last month has been a whirlwind, and we’ve got some big updates to share. The team has been hard at work pushing forward, and while there’s still a long road ahead, we’re feeling that amazing momentum that comes with hitting a major milestone. Let’s dive into what’s new!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667090/c62f0d99b7250e03216b2f00d0dee883894876c8.png"]
🚀 Demo + Steam Page Are Live!
The biggest news: our Steam page is officially live, and so is our first playable demo for Quest for the Albatross!
 This is a huge step for us, and we’re incredibly excited to finally share more of the game with you—including its name!

While we’re still in early development, the demo is a fun slice of what we’ve been building. It doesn’t reflect the full scope of the game yet (not even close!), but it gives a taste of the gameplay, tone, and magical golf chaos we’re aiming for. We’ll be updating and expanding the demo over time—so let us know what you think, and keep an eye out for future versions.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667090/4987a41a48b9d5e8d67d19f619858831c466a029.png"]
✍️ What's Next: Story & Siege Mode
Now that the demo is out, you might think we’d slow down. Nope! The journey continues, and we’re deep in development on two big pieces of the game: the story and siege mode.

📖 Story Progress

The narrative is currently about two-thirds complete, and we’re charging ahead to get that last chunk written. Without giving too much away, we think the story will really resonate with players—it’s heartfelt, a little strange, and full of fantasy charm. Once the draft is done, we’ll move into refining and editing.

🛡️ Siege Mode Incoming

Siege Mode is one of our most ambitious features. We’ve done early prototypes and mockups, but now we’re entering full development. Picture this: you, standing on a magical golf course, defending cities against waves of enemies using spells, precision shots, and strategy.
 We’re hoping to introduce a version of Siege Mode into the demo in the near future—stay tuned for updates as it comes together!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667090/b3e662135e0b8c2f28e8e806a9b3667e28af7fb9.png"]
💬 Join the Community!
We’d love for you to join us on this wild ride. The best way to stay in the loop is through our Discord ( https://discord.gg/u9phqx3RpV ) server, where you can chat with the devs, share feedback, and be the first to know what’s coming next.

Later this summer, we’ll be launching a Kickstarter campaign to help bring Quest for the Albatross to life in the best way possible. If you believe in what we’re building, we’d love to have your support.

Thanks so much for being here. More updates soon—and as always, keep swinging!

🏌️

— Austin Lane
 Game Director / Programmer
